hypothesis: Existing attention scores local regions independently. Make local lesion evidence depend on the whole image through bounded residual global-context queries, preserving common initialization and compact disease marginalization.
architecture: Reuse M5 projected128Dregions and2attentionheads. A shared128->16key and context->2*16query give dotproduct/sqrt16; add strength*tanh(score) to original scores. Queryweights/bias initializedzero; key ordinarylinear. Context uses projectedglobal256D or global+mid+dispersion384D. No context-dependent value modification.
common_initialization: New module initialized after every commonM5tensor, leaving all common tensors and initial predictions identical under the same seed. No changes to data, patient weighting, loss, hparams or stopping.
selection: HigheroriginalpatientCV and no validationMacroF1decrease vsM5. Eligiblebestmust be fixed and confirmed on fresh patient partitions againstM5andfixedGaussian before any freeze or external scoring.
external_test_policy: No external scoring, labels, predictions or rawimages. Only development indices0..2090 used in new analyses.
